cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to the swimming club! I'm delighted to have you. I'll arrange your first swim once you've completed induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. Can I join today's induction?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd be pleased to put you on the next one after you've observed today. I'll save you a place in the gallery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could I watch from the poolside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to have you beside us, but I can't waive the induction rule for poolside access. Let me choose you a brochure with a lovely view; you can sit with me at reception.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 arranges swimming, A3 controls induction sequence and gallery place, A5 declines waiving poolside access while inviting company at reception; warmth and authority govern the same restriction.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 induction request causes A3 observation first; B4 gallery closure causes A5 no poolside and brochure/reception alternative.

relationship.evidence: B2 enthusiastic newcomer and B4 alternate location are plausible participation attempts A acknowledges warmly.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 unavailable gallery to reveal another prerequisite yet offers personal company, increasing both confinement and welcome.

specificity.evidence: A1 swim/induction, A3 gallery and A5 reception give concrete places and access terms.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 lovely view in brochure is caused by B4 loss of real observation; the personal invitation keeps it sincere.
